name: todo-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Verifies the gateway's signed assertion for every request and resolves the caller's identity.

description: Backend service owning the todo entity: create, list, and complete/reopen a todo, scoped strictly to the signed-in caller (resolved from the gateway assertion, never a client-supplied id). Persists entries in todo-db. Does not support editing a todo's title or deleting a todo, and sends no notifications.
